# Build How-To: Bloodstained Max Crit Commando Sniper

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_121_nukaknights-post-build-bloodied-crit-commando.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This build is played a lot in this and similar forms and is likely to be a kind of new meta build. The build can deal high damage while remaining undetected. This means he can easily deal with large opponents. The focus here is on **automatic rifles**, landing **critical hits in the V.A.T.S.** and the **Herbivore** mutation (to get the appropriate bonuses). As the name suggests, this build plays at low HP (under 20% at best) in order to get the maximum bonuses and do the most damage.

## Equipment

This build takes advantage of the command perks unique to automatic rifles and actively plays the following **rifles**:

- Quadruple +50crit BS track rifle (of course a Q50crit25 would be even better)
- B50crit15 Cleaner
- V50crit25 Cleaner
- B50crit25 radium rifle
- and a few more depending on your mood
- Good is always Quadruple / Bloodstained / Vampire with 50 crit and 25 less VATS action point costs, 15% faster reload or the critical hit bar is filled 15% faster.

All automatic rifles are playable (assuming appropriate mods): Handmade, Cleaner, Track Rifle (loud), Assault Rifle, Radium Rifle, Laser Rifle (loud), Plasma Rifle (loud), Enclave Plasma Rifle (loud), Impro Rifle, Tesla Rifle (loud), Alien Disintegrator (moderately loud but no silencer). However, depending on the volume of the weapon and whether or not there is a silencer, the build will be discovered more quickly. If the enemies are further away, you can also stay detected with a loud weapon. So you should adapt to the situation.

![](/uploads/bloodied-crit-commando-build-quad-railway-a0de336e-6d40-43e6-ad65-81eadb17cc7f.jpg)

![](/uploads/bloodied-crit-commando-build-fixer-d4fbadf4-d4bf-4970-97ef-d1e2c62bb17f.jpg)

The **armor** is a Secret Service armor with jetpack mod on the chest part, all parts with Unyielding effect. The build should have the following additional effects on the armor:

- 3 parts with AP acceleration
- 1 part with HTD (harder to detect when sneaking)
- Reducing weight on weapons never hurts either.
- Poison resistance is also helpful
- The first mod should be "**Supported**" on all parts
- The 2nd mod for the body parts "**Ultralightweight**"
- For the torso I like to use the **Jetpack** as the second mod, but for daily operations with exploding enemies you can also use "**Compacted**" and for Earle (against the falling rocks) the "**Asbestos-fed**" mod.

The Secret Service armor is the best armor (not power armor) in the game (taking into account availability and options, as well as resistances), which you can buy in Vault 79 for gold from Regs (Secret Service).

As **underarmor** I use the Secret Service underarmor with shielded mod. This gives the following bonuses +4 STR, +2 PER, +4 END. It is also easily available for gold from Regs in Vault 79. 

Alternatively, you can also e.g. Use the Raider Underarmor with Shielded Mod, as the SPECIAL bonuses bring even slightly higher advantages: +3 PER, +3 AGI, +1 LCK. However, the plan for the shielded variant is very rare and therefore not easily available.

In addition, the build uses a **backpack with pharmacist mod** (available from the raiders for gold), which replaces the perk card "Travel Pharmacy" to 3*.

![](/uploads/bloodied-crit-commando-build-rucksack-356f1b08-bd81-4d14-af6d-d483790f79f2.jpg)
